keyDates.text: Brown ED / Harvard SCEA / Yale SCEA / Princeton SCEA early decision notifications expected by mid-December 2026 for Class of 2031
Joshua Kennedy '97 becomes Brown's new Chief Investment Officer, succeeding Jane Dietze
Regular Decision deadlines: Harvard/Princeton/Columbia/Dartmouth (Jan 1), Yale/Cornell (Jan 2), Brown/Penn (Jan 5)
Early implementation window opens for ED's new Accreditation, Innovation, and Modernization (AIM) final rule
House Education and Workforce Committee chair race to be decided; Bobby Scott, Jahana Hayes, and Suzanne Bonamici competing for chairmanship
ED AIM accreditation final rule takes full effect — accreditors must update standards and procedures
National enrollment confirmation/deposit deadline for Class of 2031
Ivy League Regular Decision notifications expected: Harvard/Yale/Princeton late March; Brown/Penn early April (Ivy Day 2027 TBA)
